title: Keep the renamed-customer report file name as it is?
bluf: Narrowed: of the three tickets, HPSMPOC-237 was ruled on 21 Oct (hpsmpoc-review-week-larger-plan-1021, option b, the larger plan; the UAT plan stands at P0v3 per CLARIFICATIONS C-135) and HPSMPOC-246's notes were ruled on 13 Oct and built, so neither needs a card. One question remains (HPSMPOC-203): an issued report downloads under the renamed customer's file name while its pages print the old name. Keeping it is low severity; making the file keep its issue-time name needs a database change. Default if you do not tap: option A, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-203

options.label: Keep as is
options.detail: The file name follows the live customer record. Recorded as ruled.

options.label: Keep the issue-time name
options.detail: Needs the name stored on the report row, a database change.

default_action: Option A: keep as is; record ruling.
